label: Japan
identity_note: The Japanese revision 1 disc's partition boot.bin (read at 0x80000000, checked by game_folder.cpp) and its header both say revision 1, the USA build's number, so only the game code changes. Its main.dol is revision 0's but for the version in the game's own disc ID (0x8001BC9C). It has Japanese text only, so the default language is jp.
identity: This port runs only revision 0 (Dolphin shows it under Properties > Info).
